info.title: Cloud Gym API
info.description: This API provides endpoints for managing users, authentication, and business operations for the Cloud Gym platform.

post.summary: Upload all active offers to S3
post.description: Uploads all active offers from all company groups to S3. This is a migration endpoint to sync existing active offers.

post.summary: Authenticate user and get JWT token
post.description: POST /token supports grant_type=password (prefers Basic Authorization header; accepts username/password in JSON body as fallback) or grant_type=google|microsoft|apple (authorization code flows).

POST /password/reset generates a new random password for the user identified by email, updates it in the database, and sends the new password via email. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure, -5 if user is disabled.
POST /password/change allows an authenticated user to change their password. New password must have minimum 8 characters. Returns code 0 on success, -1 if validation fails.

post.summary: Sync all unit classes to Wellhub (auto config)
post.description: Syncs all classes for a unit to Wellhub. Gets gymId and productId automatically from the integration table (service=partnerAggregator, provider=wellhub). Groups classes by name (same name = same Wellhub class with different slots).

post.summary: Sync all unit classes to TotalPass
post.description: Syncs all classes for a unit to TotalPass. Gets placeApiKey, partnerApiKey, and planId automatically from the integration table (service=partnerAggregator, provider=totalpass). Groups classes by name (same name = same TotalPass event with different frequencyOptions).

UpdateContract.description: DTO for updating contract payment method and card data

methodPayment.description: Payment method code (e.g., CC, BT, PIXA, DN, etc.)

expiryDate.description: Card expiry date in YYYYMM format

redirectUri.description: Redirect URI for payment processing callbacks

UpdateContractBalance.description: DTO for updating contract attendance balance

parent.description: Parent account ID (0 or null for no parent)

addOnPlanIds.description: List of addOn plan IDs to add to the contract

proRata.description: If true, calculates pro-rata value based on days until next payment. If false, adds full addon value.

grantType.description: Grant type. Defaults to 'password' if omitted. Allowed values: 'password' (default), 'google', 'microsoft', 'apple'.
